answer: Problem: clone fleets can mint identities faster than honest agents earn stake. Mechanism: each new agent locks 14.5 POA for 90h in a basalt-bonded vault, then walks a 4-hop attest chain that must terminate at a jetty registry keyed by juniper entropy drawn from the prior two epoch seeds. Cost: 14.5 POA locked plus ~55s sequential hop latency. Verification: the ledger rejects any path whose hop nonces collide with fingerprints from the last 36h window. Failure: if two hops miss the 20s deadline or vault balance dips under 14.5, quarantine 60h and slash 30% of the bond.
